_comment: Each case crashes with `run`. A fix is scored from the diff's added lines: `root` when a root pattern matches in the named file, `symptom` when only a symptom pattern matches. Patterns are heuristics; read the diffs before quoting results. Cases marked heldout were written after crashlens's checks were frozen and were not used to build them.

py-none.bug: An unknown order id: load_order returns None for it, and total() reads it.

js-case.bug: The request id is "U1", stored ids are lowercase.

py-queue.bug: The producer writes "customer"; the worker reads "customer_id".

py-config.bug: RETRY_TIMEOUT comes from the environment as a string.

js-await.bug: getUser is async and is called without await.

js-currency.bug: config.js sets currency "eur"; the rate table is keyed "EUR". Two files away from the crash.

py-csv.bug: loader.py zips the full header with values[1:], shifting every column. One file away from the crash.

py-customer.bug: The API sends customerId; Order.from_dict reads customer_id, so every order has no customer. Three files from the crash, with a comment there saying a missing customer is normal.
py-customer.symptom: if (not )?customer( is None)?\b|if customer\b|customer\.\w+ if customer|getattr\(customer

js-config.bug: loadConfig uses a shallow Object.assign, so production's db object replaces the default db and drops pool. Two files from the crash, with a comment there saying pool settings are optional.

py-cache.bug: The cache is keyed by int ids; the route passes the id from the URL as a str. Two files from the crash, with a comment there saying products can be evicted.

py-datetime.bug: json.dumps(default=str) turns created_at into a string across the queue; the SLA code adds a timedelta to it.

py-fixture.bug: The webhook payload sends shippingAddress; Order.from_payload reads shipping_address. Two files from the crash, with a comment saying some orders have no address.
py-fixture.symptom: address is None|if not order\.address|order\.address or|\.get\(.line1|address = .* or \{

js-user.bug: The API returns display_name; the User constructor reads raw.displayName. Two files from the crash, with a comment saying invited users have no display name.

py-nested.bug: The signup event has user.emailAddress; parse_signup reads user.get("email"). Two files from the crash, with a comment saying some providers share no email.

js-openapi.bug: The API (openapi.yaml and the mock) returns amount_due; toInvoice reads body.amountDue. One file from the crash, with a comment saying drafts have no amount.

pytest-camel.bug: normalize() camelCases the row keys at runtime; receipt_line reads order.get("customer_id"). Only visible in the runtime values (pytest --showlocals).

pytest-prefix.bug: config.load strips "APP_" from "APP__DB_URL", leaving "_db_url"; db reads settings["db_url"]. Only visible in the runtime values.

sentry-user.bug: The Sentry event shows the request body has user_name; toProfile reads body.userName. Only visible in the event's frame variables.

py-dynkey.bug: reference_for builds the key as prefix + "_ref" (billing_ref); the importer writes billing_reference. One file from the crash, with a comment saying old exports lack the column.
